description:
We are looking for an exceptional C++ quantitative developer to play a key role in building and scaling our High Frequency Trading (HFT) infrastructure.
 This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing team and help shape the next generation of our ultra-low-latency trading systems. You will take ownership of critical components, from architecture and design through development and production, working closely with quantitative researchers and experienced technologists to solve complex engineering challenges.
 Your contributions will have a direct impact on our trading performance, helping drive innovation, enhance execution capabilities, and support Trexquant's continued growth in the competitive HFT landscape.
 
 Responsibilities 
 Work with quantitative researchers and developers to implement and improve strategies.
 Add new trading venues and tightly integrate them with our trading system and strategies.
 Optimize tick-to-trade latency across hardware and software layers, including CPU architecture, cache and memory efficiency, Linux kernel tuning, and network interface cards (NICs).
 Partner with quantitative researchers to translate strategy requirements into performant, reliable production systems.
 Contribute to market data normalization and analysis to ensure quick cycle times for quantitative research
 Ensure a clean, well-tested, and thoroughly documented codebase; participate in code review and share knowledge with junior engineers.
 Requirements 
 Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 2+ years of professional experience in C++, Python, and Linux, with a strong understanding of low-level memory management, concurrency, lock-free programming, and performance optimization.
 Proven experience developing ultra-low-latency, high-throughput systems, in trading or other real-time environments.
 Strong knowledge of profiling tools and techniques for latency measurement and benchmarking (e.g., perf, cachegrind, flame graphs, hardware timestamping).
 Hands-on experience with network protocols (TCP/UDP, multicast, Ethernet) and low-latency messaging systems.
 Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.
 Benefits 
 Competitive salary plus bonus based on individual and company performance.
 Collaborative, casual, and friendly work environment.
 PPO Health, dental and vision insurance premiums fully covered for you and your dependents.
 Pre-tax commuter benefits.
 Weekly company meals.
 
 Applications are open for both Stamford, CT and New York City offices.
 
 The base salary range is $175,000 to $200,000 depending on the candidate’s educational and professional background. Base salary is one component of Trexquant’s total compensation, which may also include a discretionary, performance-based bonus. This position is classified as overtime-exempt.
